description: This file defines a Swift class 'TalkOverlayController' that manages the presentation and updating of a talk overlay UI component. It handles window creation, presentation, dismissal, and state updates such as visibility, phase, pause status, and level. It also includes a nested view hosting class 'TalkOverlayHostingView'.

classes.name: TalkOverlayController
classes.description: A final class responsible for managing the talk overlay's window, view, and state.

classes.name: TalkOverlayHostingView
classes.description: A private subclass of NSHostingView that accepts first mouse events.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays the overlay window at the designated position, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Hides the overlay window if visible, with animation.

methods.name: updatePhase
methods.description: Updates the current talk mode phase and logs the change.

methods.name: updatePaused
methods.description: Updates the paused state and logs the change.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the overlay's level (volume) if the overlay is visible.

methods.name: currentWindowOrigin
methods.description: Returns the current origin point of the overlay window.

methods.name: setWindowOrigin
methods.description: Sets the origin point of the overlay window.
